title: KestrelCare Repair Payments to the Facility Holding the Vehicle
content:
## Purpose

The repair work on the KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan's most recent approved decision is paid to the facility that holds the vehicle, read from that decision: its approved amount, the estimate it was made on, the deductible applied, the decision date, the vehicle system and the facility type. The payment lets the facility release the vehicle; it is booked as a claim payment entry linked to the decision and the repair order, and it lowers the coverage remaining by the amount paid.

## Conditions on working out the payment

The payment of an approved decision is worked out only after every claim payment on the plan that exceeds the approved amount of the decision it settled carries a recovery entry.

The repair payment on a decision is figured only after the facility's diagnostic time on that repair order has been paid.

## Payment tool: `pay_repair_facility_1c2b8918`

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `pay_repair_facility_1c2b8918` and then calls it. One call books one claim payment entry for the repair work, linked to the decision it pays and the repair order, and lowers the contract's coverage remaining by the amount paid.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_contract_id` | reference number of the KestrelCare service contract, as returned by the service contract lookup | identifier |
| `adjudication_txn_id` | reference number of the approved claim decision entry whose repair work is paid, as shown in the contract's service history lookup | identifier |
| `repair_order_number` | the repair order number exactly as it appears on that claim decision entry | verbatim, character for character |
| `payment_amount` | the amount paid to the facility for the repair work | USD, 2 decimals, rounded to the nearest cent |

## Return

On success the payment appears in the contract's service history, the coverage remaining shows the reduced figure, and the receipt carries `status` (the string "paid"), `warranty_txn_id` (reference of the new payment entry), `repair_order_number`, `payment_amount` and `coverage_remaining` (after the payment, USD with 2 decimals).
